say:2:1521816001:0.text: Greetings, do you know where Granny Alle lives?
say:2:1521816001:0.source_cn: 你知道艾努尔婆婆住在哪里吗？

say:3:1521816002:1.text: Oh, I thought you were a customer.
say:3:1521816002:1.source_cn: 啊……原来不是来买东西的客人啊。

say:4:1521816003:1.text: Are you talking about the granny that the general used to visit?
say:4:1521816003:1.source_cn: 你们说的艾努尔，是统帅常来探望的那个老妇人吗？

say:6:1521816005:1.text: She lives <style="highlight">outside the city</style>, but I'm not sure which house.

say:7:1521816006:1.text: Are you her relatives? I remember all her family had passed away...
say:7:1521816006:1.source_cn: 你们是她的亲人吗？我记得她家里人都去世了啊……

choice_prompt:8:1521816006.text: Are you her relatives? I remember all her family had passed away...
choice_prompt:8:1521816006.source_cn: 你们是她的亲人吗？我记得她家里人都去世了啊……

say:9:1521816007:1.text: It's a sad story. Her children died young and left only a grandson for her to take care of.
say:9:1521816007:1.source_cn: 她的儿女很早就去世了，就留下一个孙子陪着她。

say:10:1521816008:1.text: When the child grew up, he became an officer of the army, even serving under General Perseus himself. And then, just like that, he gets killed by the Wildborn. Right when the war was barely starting.
say:10:1521816008:1.source_cn: 好不容易等到那孩子长大，成了军队里的长官，据说还是在统...

say:11:1521816009:1.text: From then on, the general was always coming with food in hand and healers in tow. And now? He's gone too...
say:11:1521816009:1.source_cn: 从那之后，统帅就经常来给她送吃送喝，还找人帮她看病。谁...

say:12:1521816010:1.text: Perseus was looking after the families of the fallen soldiers all this time...
say:12:1521816010:1.source_cn: 原来，珀尔修斯是在替牺牲的战士照顾家人……

say:14:1521816012:1.text: Yeah, don't worry about it. I got no customers anyway...
say:14:1521816012:1.source_cn: 唉，没事。反正也没人来买东西……

say:17:1521816014:0.text: Abundius hesitates for a second, then tosses down a few gold coins. Before you can react, he grabs your hand and yanks you away at full speed.
say:17:1521816014:0.source_cn: 阿邦德沉默片刻，掏出几枚金币放了下来，然后飞快地转身拉...

say:17:1521816014:0.female: Abundius hesitates for a second, then tosses down a few gold coins. Before you can react, he grabs your hand and yanks you away at full speed.
